highlights.reason_zh: ThinkingBox 直接核验数据库终态，暴露 transcript grader 看不到的静默失败。
highlights.reason_en: ThinkingBox checks terminal database state, exposing silent failures transcript graders miss.

highlights.reason_zh: DiarizationLM 的本地 GGUF 让说话人修正可在一天内验证。
highlights.reason_en: DiarizationLM local GGUF files make speaker correction testable in one day.

highlights.reason_zh: Strata 以快速采用信号把超大稀疏模型带到消费级硬件。
highlights.reason_en: Strata brings a very large sparse model to consumer hardware with strong adoption.

highlights.reason_zh: Claude Code 2.1.289 堵住多条 managed policy 绕过路径。
highlights.reason_en: Claude Code 2.1.289 closes several managed-policy bypasses.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开 Vault API 文档满足了原先的试验门槛。
highlights.reason_en: Public Vault API docs clear the prior trial gate.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；另核查官方发布、模型卡、代码仓库、论文与到期复核。完成 18 项到期复核及每周补漏。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and read, supplemented by official releases, model cards, repositories, papers and due reviews. Eighteen due reviews and the weekly gap check were completed.
